observed.title: 312. Burst Balloons
observed.statementExcerpt: If you burst the ith balloon, you will get nums[i - 1] * nums[i] * nums[i + 1] coins; out of bounds is 1; return the maximum coins.
observed.languageSelector: Code editor exposes Python3; callable class Solution with maxCoins(nums) returning int. No mutation or callback requirement observed.
